verdict.rationale: Open WebUI's own docs describe a native sub-agents feature: a model can hand a focused piece of work to a second agent that runs in parallel, then use the result to continue. This directly addresses the story's core of splitting and parallelizing work. However, the evidence is a single docs line with no detail on depth, limits, or scale, so coverage is only partial. Missing for 10: documentation of multi-agent swarms or more than one delegated sub-agent, an agent-to-agent protocol, orchestration controls and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration that sub-agents parallelize real work.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, agents can work together — subagents, swarms, or an agent-to-agent protocol that splits and parallelizes real work

citations.quote: Sub-agents let a model hand a focused piece of work to a second agent that runs in parallel, then use the result to continue.
